notes.title: Game Update 1.03 - September 16, 2017
notes.content:
Hi guys,

We're still working on some bigger improvements to the game, but we decided it was important to issue a smaller update before we're done with those and introduce a tutorial into the game.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
    [*] Tutorial the first time the game is played
[/list]

We've noticed many first-time players having difficulty understanding that double jumping is fundamental to the game (which is our fault, we don't clearly mention it), so we hope this will help. :)

int64, Community Manager
Snowflurry Entertainment

notes.title: Game Update 1.02 - September 3, 2017
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Following the feedback we've received so far and our roadmap for features we want to continue to implement, we've just updated the game with the following changes.

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
    [*] Added Steam leaderboards (yay!)
    [*] Added support for setting mouse sensitivity
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
    [*] Fixed enemies glitching around a bit at game start
    [*] Fixed power-ups not showing as intended in the game
    [*] Fixed issue where double jumping when hitting a platform would cause a higher jump than intended
[/list]

Let us know if you run into any issues (you can do so via the Steam community forums), and have fun playing. :)

int64, Community Manager
Snowflurry Entertainment
